title: Click-chemistry protocol for detecting 4-octyl-itaconate-alkylated proteins in mouse macrophages
author: Su, Cheng, et al.

steps.title: Euthanize mouse
steps.instruction: Euthanize a C57BL/6J mouse using the approved primary and secondary euthanasia methods at your institution (e.g., CO₂, isoflurane overdose, or avertin overdose followed by a secondary physical method such as cervical dislocation).

steps.title: Disinfect mouse
steps.instruction: Spray the entire mouse with 75% ethanol. Perform the dissection in a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Harvest bone marrow
steps.instruction: Dissect out femur and tibia, remove surrounding muscle, and place bones in ice‑cold PBS. In a biosafety cabinet, soak the bones in 75% ethanol for 1 min, then transfer to fresh sterile PBS in a 60 mm tissue‑culture dish, cut off extremities, and flush the marrow with ice‑cold PBS using a 25 G syringe needle. Collect the marrow in a 50 mL conical tube, centrifuge at 500 × g for 4 min at 4 °C, and discard the supernatant PBS.

substeps.instruction: Dissect bones, soak in ethanol, transfer to PBS.
Flush marrow with 25 G needle and collect.
Centrifuge at 500 × g for 4 min, discard PBS.

steps.title: Resuspend marrow cells
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL pre‑warmed DMEM culture medium to the bone‑marrow pellet and homogenize the cell suspension by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Filter cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the cell suspension through a 70‑μm cell strainer into a new sterile 50 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Plate cells
steps.instruction: Plate the filtered cell suspension into a Thermo Scientific Nunc EasYDish 150 mm dish; typically ~20 million bone‑marrow cells from one mouse are seeded in 25 mL DMEM culture medium.

steps.title: Add M‑CSF (day 0)
steps.instruction: Add mouse M‑CSF to the culture medium to a final concentration of 40 ng/mL (designated day 0).

steps.title: Add M‑CSF (day 2)
steps.instruction: On day 2, supplement the culture medium with mouse M‑CSF to a final concentration of 20 ng/mL.

steps.title: Incubate and harvest BMDMs
steps.instruction: Culture the cells in a standard humidified incubator at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ and collect the differentiated macrophages on day 5.
